title: Dockerfile: multi-stage Rust build for server
description: Multi-stage Dockerfile. Stage 1: rust:1.85-bookworm, cargo build --release for baize-server. Stage 2: debian:bookworm-slim, copy binary + games/ + registry/ + schema/ dirs. Expose 8080. ENTRYPOINT baize-server. Health check on /health. ~50MB final image. No secrets baked in. BAIZE_BIND_ADDR and BAIZE_DATA_DIR configurable via env vars.
